content: Supabase built-in email service sends ONLY to project team-member addresses (others get 'Email address not authorized') at 2 emails/hour shared across all auth email types, best-effort no SLA. Custom SMTP is available on ALL plans including free (Resend/SES/Postmark etc.); once enabled default limit 30/hr adjustable. As of June 2026 new free-tier projects on default provider cannot customize auth email templates; custom SMTP restores that.
